_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Out of my Mind#000.src: I don't know, you guys, all these rumours seem a little far-fetched. What next? Will he suddenly turn out to be some mad scientist?

Out of my Mind#001.src: Let's go, I'll take you to the exit so that I don't waste your time any longer!
Out of my Mind#001.dst: さあ行こう、これ以上時間を取らせないよう出口まで案内するよ！

Out of my Mind#002.src: So you must be thinking, how have you never met a fine fellow such as myself until now? To be quite honest, you must have just been terribly unlucky, I used to travel the world, you know!

Out of my Mind#003.src: Oh the places I've been were wonderful! From the depths of the jungle to the lesser depths of the jungle to even my back garden, I've done my fair share of exploring, if I do say so myself!
Out of my Mind#003.dst: ああ、訪れた場所はどれも素晴らしかった！ジャングルの奥地から、ジャングルのそれほど奥でもない所、さらには我が家の裏庭まで、探検はたっぷりしてきたと自負しているよ！

Out of my Mind#004.src: You are the first normal person I've seen recently, {u}. I went out recently and was met with some very rude remarks by some very rude townsfolk!

similar.text: You are the first normal person I've seen recently, {PlayerName}. I went out recently and was met with some very rude remarks by some very rude townsfolk!

Out of my Mind#005.src: The last time I visited the town it was all empty too, but I could feel people were hiding in their homes, even on such a lovely day as then. There was no one even there to hide from! Strange people.

Out of my Mind#006.src: Here we are, the library! I could spend years in here, but who has time for that? I could talk about books for hours too! Here's one right now.

Out of my Mind#007.src: The ground is shaking... I thought that was supposed to happen later! Come back friend, I can't do this alone!
Out of my Mind#007.dst: 地面が揺れている…これはもっと後のはずだったのに！戻ってきてくれ友よ、一人じゃ無理だ！

Out of my Mind#008.src: If you remember, we were talking about keeping the door shut when suddenly something heavy fell off a shelf hitting you square in the head!

Out of my Mind#009.src: During the shaking, some of my machines broke apart, but we could use these to build something capable of dropping something heavier on your head for the second time.

Out of my Mind#010.src: Surely by that logic everything has to go well, you know. Now let me explain how we can do this. First, choose what part you want to use to make our machine, then choose were you want it to go and face.

Out of my Mind#011.src: Quick, head through the large door and stop the cause of all that shaking!

Out of my Mind#012.src: I don't know about you, Todd, but I feel we should make them our new honorary club member for finding such amazing things!

Out of my Mind#013.src: Ignore Viola, she's acting up today, probably because you've got the spotlight this time. However, I agree with Prentiss.

Out of my Mind#014.src: Welcome you to the club, new member! Here is your shiny new badge that you can parade around town to show off how cool you are to others with style.

Out of my Mind#015.src: You tell the group of kids your experiences of strange creatures, even stranger men as well as a hazy memory about... a coconut?
Out of my Mind#015.dst: 子供たちに、奇妙な生き物やもっと奇妙な男たちの話、そしてぼんやりした記憶を語る…ココナッツの？

Out of my Mind#016.src: Speak with the {p} children in the treehouse.
Out of my Mind#016.dst: ツリーハウスで {p} の子供たちと話す。

Out of my Mind#017.src: Did ye two hear about some guy wandering around town? I've heard strange rumours about him...
Out of my Mind#017.dst: おまえら、町をうろついてる奴の話聞いたか？そいつの変な噂を聞いたんだ…
Out of my Mind#017.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#018.src: Of course I have, he's the talk of the town! I heard he only brushes his teeth once a day and that he enjoys books about gardening!
Out of my Mind#018.dst: もちろん、町中の噂だもん！歯みがきは一日一回だけで、園芸の本が好きなんだって！
Out of my Mind#018.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#019.src: I don't know, you guys, all these rumors seem a little far-fetched. What next? Will he suddenly turn out to be a mad scientist?
Out of my Mind#019.dst: どうかな、あんたたち。どの噂もちょっと大げさじゃない？次は何？実はマッドサイエンティストだった、とか？
Out of my Mind#019.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#020.src: Oh shush you, we're not living inside some storybook! Besides, if he *was* a mad scientist, wouldn't he be trying to take over the city like all mad scientists in stories do?
Out of my Mind#020.dst: うるさいな、絵本の中じゃないんだぞ！それに*もし*マッドサイエンティストなら、お話のマッドサイエンティストみたいに町を乗っ取ろうとするはずだろ？
Out of my Mind#020.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#021.src: To me that doesn't sound all that strange compared to these other things I've been hearing, anyway... Something about labs and a "hermit".
Out of my Mind#021.dst: ほかに聞いた話に比べたら、それもそんなに変じゃないけど…実験室とか「ハーミット」とか。
Out of my Mind#021.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#022.src: I think that's a type of crab or something. Adults are right old weirdos sometimes.
Out of my Mind#022.dst: それってカニの一種じゃないか？大人ってたまに本当に変だよな。
Out of my Mind#022.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#023.src: Hey, a stranger! How long have you been listening to us? Didn't your mom teach you any manners?
Out of my Mind#023.dst: ちょっと、知らない人！いつから聞いてたの？お母さんに礼儀を教わらなかった？
Out of my Mind#023.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#024.src: Wait Viola, this is our chance! This stranger sure seems like they could tackle anything, even evil hermit crabs! We could just ask them to see if these rumours are true!
Out of my Mind#024.dst: 待てよ Viola、チャンスだ！この人なら何でも倒せそうだぞ、悪のハーミットクラブだって！噂が本当か確かめてもらおうぜ！
Out of my Mind#024.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#025.src: Ignore my friends over there, they're always like that, but what Prentiss said was true. This might be our only chance to really know who this mystery man really is!
Out of my Mind#025.dst: あっちの二人は気にしないで、いつもああなんだ。でも Prentiss の言う通り。謎の男の正体を知る唯一のチャンスかもしれない！
Out of my Mind#025.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#026.src: It might be a good idea to look at that weird house next to those spooky ruins south-east of the city. We found this key you could try out, but if you lose it there are some spares in our base.
Out of my Mind#026.dst: 街の南東にある不気味な廃墟の隣の、変な家を調べてみるといいかも。この鍵を拾ったから試してみて。なくしても基地に予備があるよ。
Out of my Mind#026.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#027.src: Find the hidden door next to the gate near the Undergrowth Ruins outside {p}
Out of my Mind#027.dst: {p} の外にある茂みの遺跡近く、門の横の隠し扉を見つける

Out of my Mind#028.src: Find a way inside the house at [-{~},-{~}]
Out of my Mind#028.dst: [-{~},-{~}] の家に入る方法を探す

Out of my Mind#029.src: Explore the hidden lab in search of information
Out of my Mind#029.dst: 隠された実験室を探索し、情報を探す

Out of my Mind#030.src: Hello stranger! Welcome to my humble wooden abode. Comfy, isn't it? I bet you'd like a cup of this coff-
Out of my Mind#030.dst: やあ、見知らぬ人！私のささやかな木の家へようこそ。快適だろう？このコーヒーを一杯いかが—
Out of my Mind#030.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#031.src: Oh yes, I am the affable Ariodo, friendly neighbourhood neighbour. What do you need me for?
Out of my Mind#031.dst: おお、そうとも、私は愛想のいい Ariodo、ご近所の親切なご近所さんだ。何のご用かな？
Out of my Mind#031.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#032.src: Kidnappings? Poaching? Not brushing my teeth?! Who is this lowly person you're talking about... they don't seem like a nice fellow such as myself.
Out of my Mind#032.dst: 誘拐？密猟？歯みがきをしない！？君の言うその卑しい人物は誰だい…私のような善人ではなさそうだね。
Out of my Mind#032.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#034.src: This is the room you came from. I call it the "Vivarium", creative name I came up with, right? It keeps my pets that aren't quite ready.
Out of my Mind#034.dst: ここが君が来た部屋だ。「Vivarium」と呼んでいる、独創的な名前だろう？まだ準備の整っていないペットたちを置いているんだ。
Out of my Mind#034.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#035.src: Ready for what? Well that would ruin the surprise, wouldn't it? Can't have anyone finding out before the big event!
Out of my Mind#035.dst: 何の準備かって？それを言ったらサプライズが台無しだろう？大イベントの前に誰かに知られては困るからね！
Out of my Mind#035.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#036.src: Let us go now, time is precious.
Out of my Mind#036.dst: さあ行こう、時間は貴重だ。
Out of my Mind#036.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#037.src: So you must be thinking, how have you never met a fine fellow such as myself until now? To be quite honest, you must have been terribly unlucky, I used to travel the world, you know!
Out of my Mind#037.dst: 君はきっと、なぜ今まで私のような素晴らしい人物に会えなかったのかと思っているね？正直に言えば、君がひどく不運だったのさ。私は昔、世界中を旅していたんだから！
Out of my Mind#037.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#039.src: You are the first normal person I've seen recently, {PlayerName}. I went out recently and was met with some very rude remarks by some very rude townsfolk!
Out of my Mind#039.dst: {PlayerName}、君は最近会った中で初めてのまともな人だ。この前出かけたら、とても失礼な町の人たちにとても失礼なことを言われたよ！
Out of my Mind#039.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#040.src: The last time I visited the town it was all empty too, but I could feel people were hiding in their homes, even on such a lovely day as then. There was no one even to hide from! Strange people.
Out of my Mind#040.dst: 前に町へ行ったときも誰もいなかったが、みんな家に隠れているのが分かった。あんなにいい天気の日にだよ。隠れる相手なんていないのに！変な人たちだ。
Out of my Mind#040.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#041.src: I'm just a normal guy, so why can't anyone appreciate me for once? I'm sure you do, right?
Out of my Mind#041.dst: 私はただの普通の男なのに、なぜ誰も一度くらい認めてくれないんだ？君は認めてくれるよね？
Out of my Mind#041.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#042.src: Here we are, the library! I could spend years in here, but who has time for that? I could talk about books hours too! Here's one right now.
Out of my Mind#042.dst: 着いた、図書室だ！ここなら何年でも過ごせるが、そんな時間は誰にもないだろう？本の話なら何時間でもできる！ちょうどここに一冊ある。
Out of my Mind#042.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#043.src: This is 'The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Sweeney S. Greenville' and I must say it is a hidden gem among books! One day it just suddenly appeared in here so I couldn't resist reading it. So it starts off with Sweeney S. Greenville...
Out of my Mind#043.dst: これは『Sweeney S. Greenville の冗長で苦痛に満ちた死』、本の中の隠れた名作だと断言しよう！ある日突然ここに現れて、読まずにはいられなかった。物語は Sweeney S. Greenville が…
Out of my Mind#043.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#044.src: We're here now! Take the exit right in front of you, don't mind the corridor to the right, it's only decoration!
Out of my Mind#044.dst: 着いたよ！目の前の出口から出てくれ。右の廊下は気にしないで、ただの飾りだから！
Out of my Mind#044.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#045.src: Maybe you can come back some day for a tea or coffee and a long talk about books, since I noticed you were very interested in my long-winded review! Have fun out there and don't forget, I'm always here for you!
Out of my Mind#045.dst: いつかまたお茶かコーヒーでも飲みに来て、本の話をじっくりしよう。私の長い書評にとても興味津々だったようだからね！外でも楽しんで、忘れないで、私はいつでもここにいるよ！
Out of my Mind#045.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#047.src: Build a machine to hit your head and get back to normal
Out of my Mind#047.dst: 頭を打つ機械を作って、元に戻る

Out of my Mind#048.src: Help me keep this door shut, or else my surprise will be ruined!
Out of my Mind#048.dst: この扉を押さえるのを手伝ってくれ、でないとサプライズが台無しだ！
Out of my Mind#048.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#049.src: Just keep to the sides, it's safer that way.
Out of my Mind#049.dst: 端に寄っていてくれ、そのほうが安全だ。
Out of my Mind#049.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#050.src: Just stay here for one more momen...
Out of my Mind#050.dst: もう少しだけここにいてく…
Out of my Mind#050.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#051.src: Oh my, a ghost? Wait, is this just you, my trusty friend, playing a prank on me? No? Well that certainly is a problem!
Out of my Mind#051.dst: なんと、幽霊？待てよ、頼れる友である君が私をからかっているのか？違う？それは確かに問題だ！
Out of my Mind#051.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#052.src: If you remember, we were talking about keeping the door shut when suddenly something heavy fell off a shell hitting you square in the head!
Out of my Mind#052.dst: 覚えているかな、扉を押さえる話をしていたら、突然棚から重いものが落ちて君の頭を直撃したんだ！
Out of my Mind#052.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#053.src: I think I heard something about fighting fire with fire, so I think I have a way to get you back! You are a bit too heavy for me, so we need to think of a workaround.
Out of my Mind#053.dst: 「毒を以て毒を制す」とか聞いたことがあるから、君を元に戻す方法がある気がする！君は私には少し重すぎるから、何か工夫しないとね。
Out of my Mind#053.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#054.src: During the shaking, some of my machines broke apart, but we could use these to build something capable of dropping someting heavier on your head for the second time.
Out of my Mind#054.dst: 揺れのせいで機械がいくつか壊れてしまったが、これを使えば君の頭にもっと重いものをもう一度落とす装置が作れるはずだ。
Out of my Mind#054.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#055.src: Surely by that logic everything has to go well, you know. Now let me explain how we can do this. First, choose what part you want to use to make our machine, then choose where you want it to go and face.
Out of my Mind#055.dst: この理屈なら、すべてうまくいくに決まっているさ。では手順を説明しよう。まず機械に使う部品を選び、次にそれを置く場所と向きを選んでくれ。
Out of my Mind#055.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#056.src: The [Cart] can carry the coconut from one end of the platform to another for a few tiles, while the [Fan] can push the coconut even further.
Out of my Mind#056.dst: [Cart] はココナッツを台の端から端へ数マス運べて、[Fan] はココナッツをさらに遠くへ押し出せる。
Out of my Mind#056.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#057.src: The [Hammer] is able to knock the coconut over a one space gap while the [Cannon] can shoot the coconut one grid up diagonally in the direction it is facing.
Out of my Mind#057.dst: [Hammer] はココナッツを1マスの隙間越しに打ち飛ばせて、[Cannon] は向いている方向の斜め上1マスにココナッツを撃ち出せる。
Out of my Mind#057.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#058.src: I think I hit my head too, so I'll need your help deciding where to place each part. You want to get the coconut across to the green tile, remember?
Out of my Mind#058.dst: 私も頭を打ったようだから、各部品の配置は君に決めてもらいたい。ココナッツを緑のマスまで運ぶんだよ、覚えてるね？
Out of my Mind#058.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#059.src: You're back! To be quite honest, I didn't think that would work, but I'm glad it did!
Out of my Mind#059.dst: 戻ったね！正直うまくいくとは思わなかったが、成功してよかった！
Out of my Mind#059.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#060.src: Quick, head through the large door and stop the cause of all this shaking!
Out of my Mind#060.dst: 急いで、大きな扉を抜けてこの揺れの原因を止めてくれ！
Out of my Mind#060.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#061.src: Find a way to destroy the plant monster, then return to the group in {p} at [-{~},-{~}] to report your findings
Out of my Mind#061.dst: 植物の怪物を倒す方法を見つけ、[-{~},-{~}] の {p} にいる子供たちのもとへ戻って報告する

Out of my Mind#062.src: Oh no no, this is not good! If I had known that my little pet has grown so much I would have rushed you out sooner. Now it is wilted...
Out of my Mind#062.dst: ああ、いやいや、これはまずい！私の小さなペットがこんなに育っていると知っていたら、もっと早く君を外に出したのに。今やしおれてしまった…
Out of my Mind#062.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#063.src: You did what you had to, though. I am sorry to say this friend, but I think I'll stay inside a little longer. Sorry, my only friend.
Out of my Mind#063.dst: だが君はやるべきことをやった。友よ、残念だが、私はもう少し中にこもっているよ。すまない、唯一の友よ。
Out of my Mind#063.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#064.src: We'll surely meet again in the future, so don't be sad. I'll still be the one and only friendly neighbourhood neighbour when that moment comes, I promise. Goodbye now!
Out of my Mind#064.dst: きっとまた会えるから、悲しまないで。その時が来ても、私は変わらず唯一無二のご近所の親切なご近所さんだ、約束するよ。ではさようなら！
Out of my Mind#064.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#065.src: You're back! You were gone for ages too, and what happened to your head? Who did the mystery man turn out to be?
Out of my Mind#065.dst: おかえり！ずいぶん長かったね、その頭どうしたの？謎の男の正体は誰だった？
Out of my Mind#065.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#066.src: That sounds ridiculous! Who could ever belie-
Out of my Mind#066.dst: そんなのばかげてる！誰が信じ—
Out of my Mind#066.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#067.src: Wow that sounded just like in the stories, but it came from you, so it must be true!
Out of my Mind#067.dst: すげえ、まるでお話みたいだ。でもおまえが言うんだから、本当に決まってる！
Out of my Mind#067.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#068.src: I don't know about you, Todd, but I fell like we should make them our honorary club member for finding such amazing things!
Out of my Mind#068.dst: Todd がどう思うか知らないけど、こんなすごいことを見つけたんだから、名誉会員にすべきだと思うぜ！
Out of my Mind#068.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#069.src: Why do I even try... You two would believe anything.
Out of my Mind#069.dst: なんで頑張っちゃうんだろ…あんたたち二人、何でも信じるんだから。
Out of my Mind#069.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#070.src: I'm pretty sure they mentioned something about being hit by coconut crabs, and just look at their head. One... two... two huge bumps!
Out of my Mind#070.dst: ヤシガニにやられたとか言ってたのは確かだぜ、頭を見てみろよ。一つ…二つ…でっかいこぶが二つ！
Out of my Mind#070.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#071.src: Oh fine... whatever you say, Prentiss. I'm sure they'll bring you on some wacky adventures next time around!
Out of my Mind#071.dst: はいはい…好きにすれば、Prentiss。次はきっと変な冒険に連れてってもらえるよ！
Out of my Mind#071.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#072.src: Ignore Viola, she's acting up today, probably because you're got the spotlight this time. However, I agree with Prentiss.
Out of my Mind#072.dst: Viola は気にしないで、今日はご機嫌ななめなんだ。たぶん今回は君が主役だからね。でも僕も Prentiss に賛成。
Out of my Mind#072.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#073.src: Thanks to you, we solved the case of the mystery man as well as the mystery house! For this I'd like to...
Out of my Mind#073.dst: 君のおかげで、謎の男と謎の家の事件を両方解決できた！そこで僕から…
Out of my Mind#073.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#074.src: Welcome you to the club, new member! Here is your shiny new badge that you can parade around town to show off how cool you are to the other with style.
Out of my Mind#074.dst: クラブへようこそ、新メンバー！ピカピカの新しいバッジだよ。これを着けて町を歩いて、君のかっこよさをみんなに見せつけてね。
Out of my Mind#074.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#075.src: Also since all the adults do it, we'll give you some emeralds that you rightly deserve for such an achievement. We all pitched in!
Out of my Mind#075.dst: それと、大人はみんなそうするから、この手柄にふさわしいエメラルドもやるよ。みんなで出し合ったんだ！
Out of my Mind#075.speaker: Prentiss
